state.policy_category: Travel meals. Meals and non-alcoholic drinks purchased by the traveller for themselves while away overnight on approved company travel. Excludes alcohol, and excludes any meal shared with a client or prospective client, which belongs under Client Entertainment (not supplied here).

rationale: Read literally, every item on the bill is the traveller's own meal and a non-alcoholic drink while away overnight; the mentions of wine and the client are negations describing what is not on the bill, so nothing falls outside the definition or under either exclusion.
